paragraphs.text: Children’s parties can be booked for Saturday or Sunday afternoons. The price of £120 includes two hours in the sports hall with a party leader, followed by food in the party room. Parties must be booked at least three weeks in advance.

items.quote: two hours in the sports hall with a party leader
items.prompt: How long do the children spend in the sports hall?

explanation.en: “two hours in the sports hall” → two hours. £120 is the price, but the question is “How long”.
explanation.kk: «two hours in the sports hall» → two hours. £120 — баға, ал сұрақ «How long».
explanation.ru: «two hours in the sports hall» → two hours. £120 — цена, а спрашивают «How long».

items.quote: Parties must be booked at least three weeks in advance
items.prompt: How far in advance must a party be booked?

explanation.en: “booked at least three weeks in advance” → three weeks. “At least three weeks” is three words, over the limit.
explanation.kk: «booked at least three weeks in advance» → three weeks. «At least three weeks» — үш сөз, шектен асады.
explanation.ru: «booked at least three weeks in advance» → three weeks. «At least three weeks» — три слова, больше лимита.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Look at the text. Answer the questions below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

steps.en: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. “How long” — expect a period.
steps.kk: Шек: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. «How long» — мерзім күтеміз.
steps.ru: Лимит: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. «How long» — ждём срок.

steps.en: Find “sports hall”: “The price of £120 includes two hours in the sports hall”.
steps.kk: «sports hall» сөзін іздейміз: «The price of £120 includes two hours in the sports hall».
steps.ru: Ищем «sports hall»: «The price of £120 includes two hours in the sports hall».

steps.en: The sentence has two numbers. The time is two hours; £120 is the price. Answer: two hours.
steps.kk: Сөйлемде екі сан бар. Уақыт — two hours, £120 — баға. Жауап: two hours.
steps.ru: В предложении два числа. Время — two hours, £120 — цена. Ответ: two hours.

steps.en: “How far in advance” asks for a period before the party.
steps.kk: «How far in advance» — мерекеге дейінгі мерзім керек.
steps.ru: «How far in advance» — нужен срок до праздника.

steps.en: The last sentence: “Parties must be booked at least three weeks in advance”.
steps.kk: Соңғы сөйлем: «Parties must be booked at least three weeks in advance».
steps.ru: Последнее предложение: «Parties must be booked at least three weeks in advance».

steps.en: “At least three weeks” is three words, over the limit. Write three weeks.
steps.kk: «At least three weeks» — үш сөз, шек бұзылады. Three weeks деп жазамыз.
steps.ru: «At least three weeks» — три слова, лимит нарушен. Пишем three weeks.
